title: awkward prefill lengths >= ~1537 fail on-device JIT compile (OOM)

rewrite.from: T in {1537, 1663, 1665} at d=1024 decoder scale
rewrite.equivalence_evidence: feasibility boundary - there is no after-form; the row records that these lengths do not compile on-device at all

measurement.probe: probe_pf1537: process killed by lmkd (low watermark) ~5.5 min into compile, replicated twice; pf1663: Scudo 'internal map failure (Out of memory)' SIGABRT ~7 min; pf1665 same class. pf1536/pf1664 compile in <40 s and run 22.9/23.9 ms

scope: d=1024 L=2 decoder block, on-device JIT only (AOT on a Linux host is untested for these lengths)
notes: padding to mod-128 is not just a speed rewrite - past ~1.5k tokens it is the difference between compiling and not compiling on device
